AsyncAzureOpenAI client construction (api_type=='azure' branch). `router-migrate wrap` reported no deterministic wrap for azure-openai, and router_runtime.wrap_openai() itself declines to touch Azure clients (it checks _is_openai() and leaves Azure deployments on their configured endpoint). Azure addresses models by deployment name against a tenant-specific endpoint rather than a Router catalog model id, so there is no safe automatic mapping; a human would need to decide whether to re-point a specific Azure deployment at a Router catalog model (model-map) or leave Azure traffic on Azure.
